Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC) for OCI
Description: National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019) for Cloud Service Customers (CSC) on OCI.

Requirements.Name: Cloud Tenancy Access & MFA Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Enforce mandatory multi-factor authentication for all cloud console administrators and service users.

Requirements.Name: Cloud Network Boundary & Perimeter Protection
Requirements.Description: Ensure internet ingress is prohibited to internal management interfaces and database services.

Requirements.Name: Cloud Data Protection & Storage Isolation
Requirements.Description: Ensure object storage buckets are private and all stored assets are encrypted with dedicated keys.

Requirements.Name: Continuous Cloud Monitoring & Threat Intelligence
Requirements.Description: Deploy Oracle Cloud Guard to continuously monitor tenancy security posture and alert on anomalous activities.
